name: core.openwop.connections.google-ads
description: Google Ads connection pack — OAuth2 provider for the Google Ads REST API. Reach is `openapi`: Google Ads has no first-party global MCP server; the manifest declares the global Google OAuth hosts and points at the REST API reference, consumed by the core.openwop.http nodes. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the OAuth client id/secret + developer token host-side. One of the three ad platforms Campaign Studio syncs (Google / Meta / LinkedIn Ads).
